messages:
sam: Heads-up - Prospect Nimbus POC hit two blockers on embeddings/rerank: dims mismatch errors and frequent 429s when they spike concurrent requests. Pasting logs and sample payload.

sam: log: `ERROR rerank: embedding dims 384 != index dims 768`

sam: sample: `{\"query_embedding\": [...384 floats...], \"candidates\": [[...384 floats...]]}`

priya: Did they reindex with the same encoder that produces queries? Ask which encoder/version made their stored index.

sam: They used an older in-house encoder (384-dim) for stored vectors; their app now uses redwood-embed-2 (768-dim). They didn't realize a mismatch would fail rerank.

li: Short-term mitigation: offer a conversion shim that upsamples 384->768 (simple zero-pad + optional PCA expansion) but warn on quality change. Long-term: reindex with current encoder.

sam: They also reported bursts: ~300 req/s (many small batch_size=8) and get 429s. Error: `429 rate_limit_exceeded: throughput`

priya: Can we approve a temporary POC bump? I can open escalation. Need exact RPS and window.

sam: They measured ~300 rps sustained for 10m, peaks at 600 rps for 30s.

li: Recommend increasing batch_size to reduce QPS and using our async bulk-reindex CLI for the reindex sample. Note rerank max batch is 256; large batches may increase memory usage.

ops-bot: Escalation opened: SE-2026-034 for Nimbus rate bump. Assigned priya. ETA 6h.

priya: I'll request a temporary limit bump to 500 rps for 48h while we run a 10k sample reindex. Also will loop in bizops for Dedicated pricing and PS quote for a full reindex of ~8M items.

li: I'll draft a short python snippet to pad 384->768 for a migration pass and include a note to run Optimize A/B evals.

sam: Shared a small diagnostic endpoint for them to pre-check dims: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED\" -d '{\"index\":\"nimbus-prod\",\"expected_dim\":768}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/validate-index` Response example: `{\"ok\":false,\"mismatch_count\":482,\"expected_dim\":768,\"observed_dim\":384}`

priya: Next steps: (1) temp rate bump (priya), (2) run validate + sample reindex (nimbus), (3) PS/Dedicated costing (priya+bizops), (4) migration script & quality tests (li). I'll update ticket when escalation completes.

sam: Thanks team, tagging @nimbus-poc in the support ticket. :white_check_mark:
